stories.title: Configure League Visibility (Public/Private)
stories.goal: set my league as public or private to control who can discover and view it
stories.benefit: I can control the privacy level of my league and determine whether non-members can find and view league content
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can access league visibility settings from league admin dashboard
Admin can toggle between 'Public' and 'Private' visibility modes
Public leagues are discoverable via search and can be viewed by anyone with the URL
Private leagues are hidden from search and require membership to view any content
System saves visibility setting to database and applies changes immediately
System displays clear explanation of what public vs private means for the league

stories.title: Configure Join Rules (Auto-Join vs Approval Required)
stories.goal: set whether new members can join automatically or need admin approval
stories.benefit: I can control the membership process and maintain league quality by reviewing members before they join
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can access join rules settings from league admin dashboard
Admin can select between 'Auto-Join' and 'Approval Required' join modes
Auto-join allows users to immediately become members after claiming a team or selecting fan role
Approval required mode adds users to pending approval queue that admin must review
System saves join rule setting to database and applies to all future join requests
Current members are not affected by changes to join rules

stories.title: Configure Fan Access Settings
stories.goal: control whether fans can join my league and what access level they have
stories.benefit: I can allow or restrict fan participation and engagement in my league community
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can toggle fan access on or off from league settings
When fan access is enabled, non-managers can request fan role during onboarding
When fan access is disabled, only manager roles are available during onboarding
System displays current fan count and total fan limit (if applicable)
Admin can optionally set maximum number of fans allowed in league
Disabling fan access prevents new fans from joining but does not remove existing fans

stories.title: View League Configuration Summary
stories.goal: see a comprehensive summary of all current league configuration settings
stories.benefit: I can quickly understand my league's current configuration and identify settings that may need adjustment
acceptanceCriteria: Admin dashboard displays summary card with key league settings
Summary shows visibility status (Public/Private), join rule (Auto/Approval), and fan access status
Summary shows league URL slug and external platform connection status
Summary displays league creation date and last settings update timestamp
Admin can click any setting in summary to navigate to detailed settings page
Summary updates in real-time when settings are changed

stories.title: Set League Description and About Information
stories.goal: add a description and about information for my league
stories.benefit: potential members and fans can learn about my league's culture, rules, and community before joining
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can access league description editor from league settings
Admin can enter multi-paragraph text description with basic formatting (line breaks, links)
System supports descriptions up to 2000 characters
Description is displayed on league landing page for both members and non-members (if public)
System auto-saves description as admin types with visual confirmation
Admin can preview how description appears to visitors before publishing

stories.title: Configure Public Content Visibility for Private Leagues
stories.goal: control which content is visible to non-members even when league is private
stories.benefit: I can share specific content publicly (like power rankings) while keeping other content private (like posts and comments)
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can access granular content visibility settings for private leagues
Admin can individually toggle visibility for: Power Rankings, Matchups, Playoff Brackets, Transactions, League History
Settings only apply when league visibility is set to Private
Public content from private leagues is accessible via direct URL but not searchable
System displays warning that making content public may reveal league member information
Changes to content visibility apply immediately to all non-member visitors

stories.title: Manage League Admin Roles and Permissions
stories.goal: grant admin permissions to other league members to help manage the league
stories.benefit: I can share administrative responsibilities with trusted members and delegate league management tasks
acceptanceCriteria: Primary admin can view list of all current league members with their current roles
Primary admin can promote any manager or fan to admin status
Primary admin can demote other admins back to regular member status
System prevents primary admin (league creator) from losing admin status
Promoted admins receive notification of their new permissions
All admin actions are logged with timestamp and admin who performed the action

stories.title: Configure Notification and Communication Settings
stories.goal: control how the league communicates with members via notifications
stories.benefit: I can manage member engagement without overwhelming them with notifications
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can access notification settings from league configuration page
Admin can enable/disable notifications for: new moments, commissioner posts, trade alerts, weekly reminders
Admin can set default notification preferences for new members
Individual members can override league defaults with their personal preferences
System provides estimated notification frequency based on current settings and league activity
Changes to notification settings are applied immediately and communicated to members

stories.title: View and Audit League Settings Change History
stories.goal: see a history of all changes made to league settings
stories.benefit: I can track who changed settings, when they were changed, and revert if needed
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can access settings change history from league admin dashboard
History displays all settings changes with timestamp, admin who made change, and what was changed
History shows before/after values for each setting change
History is sortable and filterable by date, admin, and setting type
System retains settings history indefinitely for audit purposes
Admin can export settings history as CSV for external recordkeeping
